description: This file implements the SchemaInfo class methods for managing and analyzing function schemas, including argument handling, aliasing, mutability, and nondeterminism checks within the PyTorch codebase.

classes.name: SchemaInfo
classes.description: A class for managing and analyzing function schema details, including argument aliasing, mutability, and nondeterminism within the PyTorch framework.

methods.name: addArgumentValue
methods.description: Adds a single argument value to the schema info by name.

methods.name: addArgumentValues
methods.description: Adds multiple argument values from a vector or map.

methods.name: hasInputArgumentNamed
methods.description: Checks if an input argument with the given name exists.

methods.name: is_mutable
methods.description: Determines if the schema or a specific argument is mutable.

methods.name: is_nondeterministic
methods.description: Checks if the schema represents a nondeterministic operation.

methods.name: may_alias
methods.description: Checks if two schema arguments may alias each other.

methods.name: may_contain_alias
methods.description: Checks if two schema arguments may contain alias relationships, optionally bidirectional.

methods.name: wildcardSet
methods.description: Returns the set of arguments marked as wildcards.

methods.name: containerSet
methods.description: Returns the set of arguments marked as containers.

methods.name: getNonDeterministicOps
methods.description: Returns a list of schemas for nondeterministic operations.

methods.name: getTrainingOps
methods.description: Returns a list of training-related operation schemas.

methods.name: initSchemaInfo
methods.description: Initializes schema information, including alias and container sets.

methods.name: generateAliasMaps
methods.description: Generates alias mapping data structures for arguments.
